lines.t:
A function that transfers a <c:ffff00>{{part}}<c> to refit a <c:ffff00>{{medabot}}<c>
mid-<c:ffff00>{{robattle}}<c>.
The EX {{part}} to transfer must be set beforehand, in
any one <c:ffff00>{{slot}}<c> other than the <c:ffff00>{{head}}<c>.
Only the <c:ffff00>{{leader}}<c> can use it, once per {{robattle}}, which
reveals who the {{leader}} is. It cannot be used if that
{{slot}} is <c:ffff00>destroyed<c>.
No <c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c> or <c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c>: a fixed wait is needed, during
which all <c:ffff00>negative statuses<c> are nullified.
